rules.statement: The burden of proving that a person is not practicing medicine for gain, as defined by the Medical Registration Ordinance, section 20, lies with the accused.
rules.supporting_quote: "It is clear from section 105 of the Evidence Ordinance, No. 14 of 1895, that it is for the accused to prove the existence of any circumstance on which they rely to bring themselves within the benefit of section 20."
